objective: Run the exact frozen Mini-ORIGIN v0.79 selector and exact solver architecture on the seven independently sourced PMLB tables hash-locked by v0.81, with independent Rust replay.

adapter_protocol.raw_verification: raw gzip byte length and SHA-256 must match the v0.81 lock before decompression
adapter_protocol.decompression: Python standard-library gzip.decompress only after successful raw-byte verification
adapter_protocol.table_parser: Python standard-library csv.reader with tab delimiter; no dataframe library
adapter_protocol.header: one unique nonempty header row; exact target column name target; all other columns in declared table order are features
adapter_protocol.shape: record count equals frozen instances and feature-column count equals frozen features
adapter_protocol.values: missing feature cells become the empty token; other cells are stripped strings; target cells must be nonempty
adapter_protocol.sparse_or_malformed_rows: reject rows whose column count differs from the header

failure_policy.insufficient_dataset_states: preserve a scientific rejection without lowering the gate
failure_policy.python_rust_mismatch: preserve a correctness rejection and stop performance claims

claim_boundary: A pass is a fresh, repository-audited blind test of the frozen v0.79 small-query-aware Mini-ORIGIN method on seven byte-locked PMLB datasets from a separately maintained source. It is not outside-human reproduction, direct state-of-the-art superiority, peer review, publication acceptance, a general AI breakthrough, or a world-first claim.
